blocks.text: Rosario Dawson has shared a first look at her Spider-Man : Brand New Day cameo as Claire Temple (Night Nurse).
The scene originally didn’t make the cut that Marvel fans saw in theaters earlier this year, but it will be included in the re-release of the film slated for December 4.
“It’s a brand new BRAND NEW DAY with our friendly neighborhood Spider-Man…!” Dawson shared on Instagram.

blocks.text: Dawson included a photo of herself in scrubs alongside Tom Holland’s Spider-Man, wearing a mask to stay incognito as he recovered in the hospital.
“So excited to enjoy this record-breaking movie on the big screen (starting on December 4th) with an extended cut of new scenes and surprises… Ahhhh!” Dawson added.
Earlier this year, while attending GalaxyCon in Raleigh, North Carolina, Dawson revealed she had filmed a scene for Spider-Man: Brand New Day , but it was cut .

links.text: filmed a scene for Spider-Man: Brand New Day , but it was cut

blocks.text: “Well … I’m going to have to say: I could have said Spider-Man,” Dawson said after a fan asked what character she would like her Daredevil character to work with. “I even shot a scene in the new Spider-Man movie. But I got cut out.”

She continued, “I know. I told my mom, and she was like, ‘That sucks. Now I can’t post the [behind the scenes] pictures [on social media].’ And I was like, ‘Right mom. Me being cut out of the movie that has, like, the largest viewership of a trailer ever, the issue is you can’t post your BTS photos.'”
Dawson has played Claire Temple across multiple Marvel shows like Jessica Jones , Luke Cage , Iron Fist and The Defenders .
